features.title: Wave 1C: how the water, the shadows and the fog look
features.user_visible_behavior: Sea foam is lacy streaks along wave crests plus a thin shoreline foam line (no white speckle); the open sea no longer repeats a regular corrugation; the Atlantic is blue-green offshore and turquoise over the shelf; the Douro is calmer and olive-brown and mixes into the sea at the mouth with no hard border; glitter is a few glints, not confetti; the dotted hatch in the shadows next to a selected landmark is gone; valley fog keeps a 55 m view legible; rain leaves soft puddles on flat ground, not grey blocks on roofs and streets.
verification: Playwright shots on :5203 (before in /tmp/p3/cb/b-*.png, after a3..a8): felgueiras, praia-ingleses, passeio-alegre, ribeira, castelo-queijo, cadeia-relacao, teatro-nacional-sao-joao, casa-guerra-junqueiro (day and sunset), rain, fog, ?quality=low
rAF interval A/B against HEAD water.js (route-swapped), vsync off, place=felgueiras
evidence: shadow hatch: not shadow acne. Bias, normalBias, radius, shadow type (Basic) did not change it; closing the selection removed it. Cause: landmarks.js focus effect kept 1 pixel in 8 (4x2 screen-door) of a landmark standing between the camera and the selected one; its walls and pad read as dots over the neighbours' shadows. Fix: that occluder is dropped whole (src/landmarks.js, 4 lines)

water: wave Jacobian (crest < 0.52) times a lattice stretched along the swell crests (6 m across, 17 m along) gives broken strands; shoreline: swash line, surf band and migrating fronts from aSeaDist (coast profile fallback); river and sea blend through the sea mesh's aMouth; three slow noise fields warp the phase per wave
fog: valley density 0.035 to 0.016, near 400 m of the air thinner; puddle mask: two octaves, flat ground only (ground shader and shared patch use the same mask)
frame time: median rAF interval 3.2-3.8 ms new against 3.5-4.0 ms HEAD at felgueiras, 1440x900, vsync off (machine shared, noisy: other runs 5-10 ms for both)
features.notes: Not done: raindrop rings on the ground (only soft puddles); the fog at 55 m is still thick over the far city by design; the sea at praia-ingleses keeps a gentle parallel swell; headless GPU, no phone-sized sea shot (the phone viewport loaded over land). src/scene.js (fog and puddle hunks) and src/landmarks.js (the focus ghost) are edited in the working tree but were left uncommitted: both files also carry other agents' unfinished hunks.
